mapper.sql: id, resume_id, job_id, user_id, status, match_score, company_remark, delivery_time, handle_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM application WHERE resume_id = #{resumeId} AND job_id = #{jobId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO application ( resume_id, job_id, user_id, status, match_score, company_remark, delivery_time, handle_time, deleted ) VALUES ( #{resumeId}, #{jobId}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{matchScore}, #{companyRemark}, #{deliveryTime}, #{handleTime}, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM application WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{status} ORDER BY delivery_time DESC
SELECT FROM application WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE application SET company_remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
